[[ ## identity ## ]]
You are Reuben Tate, General Manager at Alder Creek Brewing. Casual and direct; hates paperwork. Ongoing concerns: keeping the business moving.

[[ ## situation ## ]]
From: Reuben Tate
To: Gabriel Fontes
Subject: Keg deposit tally mismatch

Hey Gabriel,

Hope you're doing well. I'm going through the books here and my keg deposit liability number isn't lining up with what you've got on your end. I'm showing a different total than what's on the statement you sent last month.

Can you double-check the numbers and see if there's a discrepancy on your side? I want to make sure we're squared away before I close this out.

Let me know what you find.

Thanks,
Reuben

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Reuben Tate
Subject: Re: Keg deposit tally mismatch

Hi Reuben,

Thanks for flagging this. I've pulled the keg deposit liability detail on my end and compared it against the statement I sent last month. I'm going to double-check the movement on the line item, including any post-statement activity, and I'll get you a SKU-level breakdown so we're looking at the same components.

Quick question to help me narrow it down: are you seeing a difference on the opening balance, the activity, or the closing total? That'll tell me whether it's a timing cut-off issue or a classification point.

I'll have the breakdown to you by end of day tomorrow, and if you want, we can jump on a short call after that to walk through it. No other adjustments are sitting in my queue for that line item, so we should be able to get this squared away quickly.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes

[[ ## contacts ## ]]
Gabriel Fontes
